generation.scope: All standard windows with a regular normal linear plane quotient are classified by explicit special-value forms for every projective Jordan type, including the nonsemisimple cases and ordinary Lie central extensions. At most two plane marks occur outside the commutative point; factoring three quadrics and recomputing the alternate normal form completely decides unmarked isomorphism. Together with the two quadric classifications this exhausts the entire surface case with zero-dimensional projection fibers.
